dare_positions_user_acknowledged.name: dare_positions_user_acknowledged
dare_positions_user_acknowledged.value: "dare_positions"."user_id" is null or "dare_positions"."acknowledged_at" is not null

dares_range_with_source.name: dares_range_with_source
dares_range_with_source.value: ("dares"."kind" <> 'numeric') or ("dares"."range" is not null and "dares"."range" > 0 and "dares"."range_source" is not null)

notification_log_about_one.name: notification_log_about_one
notification_log_about_one.value: ("notification_log"."kind" in ('netted', 'pin_locked') and "notification_log"."dare_id" is null and "notification_log"."obligation_id" is null) or ("notification_log"."kind" not in ('netted', 'pin_locked') and ("notification_log"."dare_id" is null) <> ("notification_log"."obligation_id" is null))

obligation_proposals_from_bound_is_user.name: obligation_proposals_from_bound_is_user
obligation_proposals_from_bound_is_user.value: "obligation_proposals"."from_bound_claim" is null or "obligation_proposals"."from_user" is not null

obligation_proposals_to_bound_is_user.name: obligation_proposals_to_bound_is_user
obligation_proposals_to_bound_is_user.value: "obligation_proposals"."to_bound_claim" is null or "obligation_proposals"."to_user" is not null

participant_claims_creator_phone.name: participant_claims_creator_phone
participant_claims_creator_phone.where: "participant_claims"."phone_hash" is not null and "participant_claims"."claimed_by" is null and "participant_claims"."merged_into" is null

sports_games_final_has_scores.name: sports_games_final_has_scores
sports_games_final_has_scores.value: "sports_games"."final_seen_at" is null or "sports_games"."home_score" is not null

sports_games_first_drive_known.name: sports_games_first_drive_known
sports_games_first_drive_known.value: "sports_games"."first_drive_result" is null or "sports_games"."first_drive_result" in ('Touchdown', 'Field goal', 'Punt', 'Turnover', 'Something else')
